images.caption: Michoacán is known for its magical villages (officially recognized Pueblos Mágicos) and its colorful folk art. Handmade masks are a typical and highly visible art form, worn by performers, displayed in museums, and sold in shops and on street corners. They may depict devils and demons, skulls, viejitos (old people), and more.
images.alt: Michoacán is known for its magical villages (officially recognized Pueblos Mágicos) and its colorful folk art. Handmade masks are a typical and highly visible art form, worn by performers, displayed in museums, and sold in shops and on street corners.
